P01.rationale: A large portrait of a person occupies roughly the top-left quadrant of the page, serving as a strong human anchor, though it is a video-still crop rather than a full editorial portrait.

P05.rationale: The client (Conesso GmbH) is represented by a clearly framed, named portrait at meaningful size in the left column, satisfying the case-study portrait requirement.

P07.rationale: There is no press/logo wall, rating cards, review grid, or testimonial apparatus visible on the page beyond a single pull-quote attribution.

P10.rationale: A large quotation mark glyph appears on the right column, but it is modest in scale and the only decorative typographic element; no giant ghost numerals are present.

P11.rationale: Three bold key-metric stats (50%, 4 Monate, 0) with descriptive labels are displayed as real data points, and a partial circular chart graphic reinforces the 50% figure.

P12.rationale: The layout is reasonably well-filled with a large portrait, structured body copy sections, and a metrics column, giving a competent editorial density, though the right column has some loose spacing.

P13.rationale: A very subtle warm off-white paper texture is used as the background, providing a slight atmospheric quality but remaining largely flat.

P14.rationale: The portrait photo does not have overlaid body text; text is placed below and beside it in clear zones, so readability is not compromised.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup (phone, laptop, book) appears anywhere on the page.

N07.rationale: The portrait appears to be a specific individual (named CEO Ricardo Morote) captured in a real context, reducing generic stock feel, though the background is somewhat neutral.

N08.rationale: The right column has noticeable vertical gaps between the chart graphic and the metric stats, and between the quote block and the page bottom, creating some purposeless dead space.

N10.rationale: No text is placed directly over the photo without a scrim; all text sits in clean white/off-white zones separate from the image.
